turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
Hello! I'm sorry your print is late. To check your order, please send me the order number (like SC-1007) and the email address used for the order.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I'm sorry about the delay and understand your frustration. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over and help you with the delivery. Please keep your order number and the order email ready.
